plates.prompt: A wide empty sandy beach on the Oregon coast in November, seen from beach level: flat wet sand across the whole lower half and empty in the middle, gentle white surf on the left, a dark green forested headland with a rocky sea stack in the distance, grassy sand dunes on the right, soft grey-blue overcast sky with a few bright breaks, driftwood logs at the edges, cool muted daylight.

A wide sandy beach on the Oregon coast at dusk, seen from beach level: flat sand across the whole lower half and empty in the middle with a few dark scorch marks, calm sea on the left, a dark forested headland, grassy dunes on the right, a deep orange and purple sunset sky, long blue shadows, a few small smoke wisps.

A 1970s state highway department office seen from in front of a desk: wood panelled walls, a big road map pinned to a cork board, grey metal filing cabinets, a rotary phone and a coffee mug, a window with rain drops and a grey coastal sky, an orange desk lamp, a cluttered wooden desk across the bottom of the picture, an empty office chair in the middle behind the desk.

Front view of a large empty dark green chalkboard filling most of the picture, mounted on a wood panelled wall of a 1970s office, a wooden chalk tray with chalk sticks and an eraser along its bottom edge, a hanging lamp at the top, the board itself completely blank and clean.

An orange 1970s state highway department dump truck parked on a sandy access road between grassy dunes, seen from behind at an angle with its tailgate open and an empty truck bed, a wooden sawhorse barrier, orange traffic cones, the beach and grey sea in the distance, overcast cool daylight.

The top of a grassy sand dune seen from behind and slightly above, the dune crest across the lower third of the picture, a long wide beach far below and far away with the grey sea and white surf, a tiny dark shape far away on the sand, overcast sky with soft light, beach grass blowing in the wind.

A small gravel parking lot next to grassy sand dunes on the Oregon coast, seen from eye level, two parked 1970s station wagons on the left and right edges, an empty parking space in the middle foreground, a wooden fence and a small sign post without text, overcast sky, cool daylight.

A cozy modern home kitchen at night, front view of a white microwave oven standing on a wooden counter in the middle of the picture, its glass door dark, tiled backsplash, a hanging pendant lamp giving warm light, a fruit bowl and a kettle beside it, blue night through the window.

A 1970s newspaper office desk seen from the front: a typewriter, stacks of newspapers, a coffee cup, an ashtray-free tidy desk with a green banker lamp, a corkboard with pinned photos, warm golden evening light through blinds, the middle of the desk clear and empty.
